description: Retarget the offline recall HTML contract from the purchase-guide page (`docs/index.html`) to the existing published vehicle/recall viewer (`docs/models.html`) without weakening any static, catalog, projection, report, CSV, or generated-data validation.
steps: In `scrapers/recalls/validate.py`, replace `INDEX_HTML` with a purpose-specific `RECALL_VIEWER_HTML = ROOT / 'docs' / 'models.html'`.
Have `_validate_workspace()` read `RECALL_VIEWER_HTML` before calling the existing `validate_html_text()`; preserve its accumulated-error behavior and all non-page validation checks.

Rename all page-contract error prefixes in `validate_html_text()` from `docs/index.html` to `docs/models.html` while retaining exactly-one host payload, exact allowlist equality, cutoff, Chinese disclosure, text-only rendering, hardened-link, and fixed-layout token checks.
Have the host-map, cutoff, and CSS mutations in `run_self_test()` read and mutate `RECALL_VIEWER_HTML`, retaining the existing expected failure assertions.
acceptance_criteria: The normal validator exits 0 against the current catalog, eight brand data files, generated docs data, tracked audit report, and `docs/models.html`.
`--self-test` rejects drifted source-host mappings, cutoff attributes, and recall CSS from `docs/models.html` and still passes the existing catalog, registry, CSV, and transaction scenarios.
No source edit is made to `docs/index.html`, `docs/models.html`, catalog/snapshots, brand adapters, writer, site builder, or generated data.
findings: Validated 2026-10-04: `.venv/bin/python -m scrapers.recalls.validate` exited 0 (2 investigations, 2 notices, 2 events, 2 matches, 2 skips, 91 vehicles; cutoff 2026-10-01). `.venv/bin/python -m scrapers.recalls.validate --self-test` exited 0 (37 negative scenarios, 1 registry integration scenario, 22 crash-recovery scenarios). The validator now binds its static page contract and self-test mutations to `docs/models.html`; no viewer, purchase-guide, catalog, snapshot, adapter, builder, or generated-data source changed. The required audit report is present at `.agents/tasks/vehicle-recall-history-report.md`; `.agents/` remains ignored, so this feature artifact will require force-add when staging.
